User Guide, Job Profitability & UAE VAT Checklist

Complete operational guide for ALMIRZAM FREIGHT BROKER L.L.C.: Automated job files, vendor buying costs, customer sell rates, and gross margin tracking.

How to Use Job Costing & Auto Invoicing

  • Automated Job & Invoice Creation: Click + New Job in the top header or +Job in the details card. The app instantly assigns the next sequential Job File Number (e.g. AFM-2026-00002) and matching Invoice Number (e.g. AE-291020262), resets dates and client fields, and readies a clean sheet.
  • Line-by-Line Vendor Cost & Customer Sell: In each service row, enter the Vendor / Transporter Ref (e.g. carrier name, driver plate, vendor invoice #) and the Cost (Buy) amount. In the same row, enter the billable Sell Amount. The row automatically computes the line-level Profit / (Loss).
  • End-of-Job Profitability Card: Below the line-item table, the live Job Profitability & Margin Analysis card calculates the total billable sell turnover, total vendor cost, net gross profit in AED, profit margin %, and cost markup %.
  • Client Invoice Mode vs. Internal Job Sheet: Keep Hide Cost on Client Print checked when printing the invoice for customers—the vendor references, costs, and profit card hide automatically so your buying margins remain strictly confidential. Uncheck it if you want to print an internal audit job costing sheet.
  • UAE VAT Compliance: Choose Standard 5% (domestic haulage, local brokerage, waiting/detention), Zero-Rated 0% (qualifying international freight), or Out of Scope (official customs duty pass-through disbursements).

Checklist of Company Details Required Before Live Use

Verify that you have replaced all bracketed placeholders with your official documents before sending invoices to clients:

  • 1. UAE Tax Registration Number (TRN): Your 15-digit Federal Tax Authority (FTA) TRN.
  • 2. Official Contact Phone Number: Landline or operations mobile number for the letterhead.
  • 3. DED Trade Licence Number: Your Dubai Department of Economy & Tourism (DET/DED) licence number.
  • 4. Corporate Bank Account & IBAN: Bank name, branch, AED account number, 23-character UAE IBAN (AE...), and SWIFT/BIC code.
  • 5. Job & Invoice Sequence Numbers: Set your preferred prefixes and starting counters under Company & VAT Settings.
